summary: Dream by WOMBO is a popular AI art generator app for web and mobile. It transforms text prompts into digital artworks in various styles for personal, social, and commercial use.
description: Dream by WOMBO is a popular AI art generator app for web and mobile. It transforms text prompts into digital artworks in various styles for personal, social, and commercial use. Create stunning AI-generated images and cinematic videos from text prompts. Powered by state-of-the-art AI models with 100+ curated styles. Text-to-Art: Turn prompts into digital paintings. Style Selection: Choose from dozens of art styles. Mobile App: Create and share on the go. Print Shop: Order posters and framed prints.

howToUse.title: Access Dream by WOMBO
howToUse.description: Use the web app or download the mobile app to get started.

howToUse.title: Enter a Text Prompt
howToUse.description: Type any idea, concept, or phrase as your prompt.

howToUse.title: Choose an Art Style
howToUse.description: Select from a variety of art styles before generating your artwork.

howToUse.title: Generate and Edit
howToUse.description: Click 'Create' to generate your artwork. Optionally, refine or re-generate for different results.

howToUse.title: Download or Share
howToUse.description: Download your art, share with the WOMBO community, or order a print.
